title: Factorized flow-map endpoint views
hypothesis: Learned start and end endpoint codes composed through one shared flow-map network improve held-out interval-pair map and semigroup quality over native continuous (s,t) conditioning at a useful serialized-byte cost.
scope: Analytic low-dimensional ODE only; no PA260 image generation or FID claim.

data.train_endpoint_pairs: fixed 80% hash split among s<t pairs; each endpoint appears in training

training.pairing: same pair order and same x minibatches across conditions

conditions: ordinary learned additive endpoint embedding control (same parameterization)
storage_authority: torch serialized inference state including both endpoint code tables

gates.signal: Mirror beats native by >=10% map and composition error at <=10% extra actual bytes and compute on 3/3 worlds
gates.mirror_specific: Mirror also beats ordinary additive endpoint-embedding control; exact alias means no Mirror-specific value
gates.fail: No held-out quality gain or excessive byte/compute cost
gates.not_established: unstable/missing fresh world or implementation issue

boundaries: No FID or image quality claim.
The ordinary endpoint embedding control is structurally identical to Mirror and is expected to expose any relabeling.

Amendment 01 fresh worlds archived and excluded after discovering model construction consumed the shared RNG differently across conditions; amendment 02 initializes shared MLP weights and data streams identically.
Amendment 01 output archived and excluded because initial shared-MLP weights/data streams were not paired; amendment 02 is confirmatory.

development.used_for: implementation check only; no hyperparameter changes
